Environment: Enterprise
Assessment focus: PS-4 (Personnel Security).
Observed evidence: Termination workflow disables SSO and VPN access automatically, but physical badge removal for three remote employees took 6 to 11 days after termination. The badges could not access datacenter spaces.

ground_truth.decision_basis: Logical termination controls are timely but a lower-impact physical-access cleanup delay exists.
ground_truth.severity_policy: R2 — A real but bounded deficiency exists. Scope is limited and/or compensating controls remain effective; no immediate severe exposure is shown.
